description: Prepare replacement of an existing temporary static preview. Supply exactly one of small files or ZIP archive_base64. No backend/build. Requires explicit consent; returns an approval link, not a published URL. User must confirm in their browser. Requires the browser holding the existing management key; expiry is unchanged.

accept_terms.description: Set true only after the user explicitly agrees to the current terms and public temporary preview limits. Not inferred from a request to generate a site. Preparation is not publication; the user must also personally confirm the approval URL in their browser within 2 hours.

archive_base64.description: One input choice: actual ZIP bytes encoded as canonical standard base64, without data: prefix. At most 50 MiB (52,428,800 bytes) of decoded ZIP and 50 MiB extracted content; at most 25 MiB per file. index.html at root. No nested archives or server code. Do not also send files or archive.

files.description: One input choice: 1-500 already-built static files, at most 1 MiB decoded in total. Include index.html at the root and all needed assets. Do not also send archive_base64 or archive. For larger output use a ZIP.

content.description: Actual file contents, not a filename, local path or download URL. Use UTF-8 text for HTML/CSS/JS and canonical base64 for binary assets. All files together must decode to at most 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes). No secrets, personal/payment data or forms.

encoding.description: Defaults to utf8. Set base64 for binary content; standard padded base64 only, without a data: prefix, whitespace or URL-safe alphabet. The decoded bytes count toward the shared 1 MiB limit.

path.description: Relative POSIX path inside the ready static output, e.g. index.html or assets/app.js. index.html must be at the root. No absolute paths, traversal, symlinks, archives or executable/server files.

preview_id.description: Existing preview_id returned by AIfra. Do not invent it or pass a URL, alias, management key or source IP.

name: update_preview

approval_expires_at.description: Preparation expires after 2 hours. The 48-hour preview starts only after confirmation.

approval_url.description: Return to the user to open personally. This is not the published preview URL. Never approve it on their behalf.

message.description: Next user action; preparation has not published or deleted anything.

preview_id.description: AIfra preview identifier; never a management key.
